summary: Bad-price-action selectivity screen vs the canon book residual losers, with adversarial verify

result.summary: Nothing is shippable, and that is the answer. Protocol executed in full: screened all 18 pre-fill features (both tails, q20-q30/q70-q80, 2025-canon quantiles only) plus all 2-feature ANDs; 1 single + 17 ANDs clear the canon >=10pp both-years bar, but ZERO corroborate on the 713-trade universe both years — the strongest canon signals (indec_30-high & trigdens_30-low, -18pp/-18pp) show -11pp/-6pp on the universe and the best-priced rule (R5: vwap_cross_30==0 & wicky_10>=q70) shows ~0pp there, marking them as canon-subset selection artifacts. Priced anyway per protocol (fit 2025, freeze, report 2026): R5-VETO is the only rule passing the $500 good-months guardrail in both years (+$1,764 in 2025 incl. Jul-Sep -$91->+$124; +$999 in 2026), but it fails universe corroboration, is threshold-fragile (wicky q65 flips 2026 negative), and leans on a 4-trade partial July — watch-list, not ship. Every other 2025-attractive rule fails the 2026 guardrail by $2-5k because canon sizing concentrates P&L in a few large winners that win-rate-based vetoes clip (R1/R3 veto 8 sized 2026 winners; R3 went +$525/Jul-Sep +$599 in 2025 to -$4,925 in 2026). HALF-SIZE is exactly half the VETO delta throughout and rescues nothing. Bonus inverse result: prior same-day canon loss predicts BETTER next-trade win rate both years (+28pp/+22pp, n small), so loss-stop/revenge-veto rules are actively contraindicated. Baselines verified: 2025 +$19,375, 2026 +$27,711, Jul-Sep 2025 -$91, 13 months. Data: /home/user/AI-trading-agents/output/badpa_matrix.parquet.
nulls: netpath_30: low +5pp/+12pp — whipsaw path does NOT hurt canon; sign wrong both years

rng_30: n=2 in 2026 low cell; high +9pp/+6pp wrong sign — dead
lvl_churn_30 (churned entry level): low -5pp/-8pp under bar; HIGH churn is +15pp/+2pp (wrong sign) — the headline 'churned level' hypothesis is a null on canon
vwap_slope_30 (flat vwap = balance): low -22pp/+1pp — 2025-only, dies in 2026
indec_30 alone: both tails flip sign across years (low -15pp/+8pp)
churn_flow_30 (two-sided tape): high -22pp/+17pp hard sign flip — dead
cvddiv_30==1: -9pp/-23pp but n26=8 — direction consistent, forever under n; only feature worth re-testing with more 2026 data
trigdens_30 alone (over-firing=chop): LOW density is the bad tail (-19pp/-6pp), i.e. hypothesis was backwards, and it still fails 2026
yday_canon_red: +7pp/-9pp flip — yesterday's red day predicts nothing
prior_pl: continuous version adds nothing beyond prior_loss (which is inverse-signed, see findings)
All 17 canon-passing 2-feature ANDs: 0 corroborate on the 713 universe both years
HALF-SIZE action: linear 0.5x of VETO in every case; never changes any rule's verdict
